== Summary ==
Black-bordered errata card for [[Dengar's Blaster Carbine (Decipher Errata 1998)]], built by swccg.com on 22 November 2026 in the card maker ([https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-cardmaker swccg-cardmaker], commit 5e952de, the same code as [https://swccg.com/cardmaker/ swccg.com/cardmaker]) from Decipher's printed card [[Dengar's Blaster Carbine]] (Dagobah, 1997), with the game text replaced by Decipher's errata word for word (Glossary Version 2.0, November 1998). Everything else (frame, picture, title, lore, destiny, icons, legal line) is as printed; the text is set again, so its line breaks may differ.

No Decipher printing with the errata words exists as a clean scan on the wiki (only a photo of the white-bordered Revised card), and the Players Committee's D-E1 card adds a comma, so Bill ruled on 22 November 2026 that this card is made in the card maker (swccg-guild/work #1297).

Maker's mark: swccg.com 2026, printed at the end of the legal line.

SHA-1 <code>7fcb85439405af4cfe3c4cf877a72d69fbe39d74</code>.

Fair use rationale: an image of a copyrighted Decipher card (© Decipher Inc. and Lucasfilm Ltd.), used only to show the errata'd card on this non-commercial fan wiki.
